app.name: Tournament Manager
app.tagline: Run chess tournaments: pairings, results and live standings.

home.title: Chess tournaments, run calmly.
home.body: Set up a Swiss, round robin, knockout or team event, enter results board by board, and let players follow live standings on their phones.

errors.invalid: Fill in your name, a valid email and a password of at least 8 characters.
errors.exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

dashboard.title: My tournaments
dashboard.empty: No tournaments yet. Create your first one to get started.

format.swissHint: Everyone plays every round against opponents with a similar score. Best for open events.
format.round_robinHint: Everyone plays everyone. Best for small groups.
format.teamHint: Teams play matches on several boards.

setup.title: New tournament
setup.name: Tournament name
setup.roundsHint: You can change this until the first round is paired.
setup.tiebreaksHint: Tick the tiebreaks to use and put them in order. FIDE-recommended ones are pre-selected.

errors.name: Give the tournament a name.
errors.dates: The end date can't be before the start date.

flags.duplicateFide: Same FIDE ID as another player

errors.rating: Rating must be between 1000 and 3000, or empty for unrated.
errors.fideId: A FIDE ID contains only digits.

import.title: Import players
import.body: Upload a CSV file or paste rows copied from Excel or Google Sheets. The first row must be the column headers.
import.columns: Recognised columns: name (or first name and last name), FIDE ID, rating, federation, birth year, club, email. Headers can be in English, Italian or Spanish.
import.missingName: We couldn't find a name column. Add a header such as "Name" or "Last name".
import.ready: {ok, plural, one {# player ready} other {# players ready}}
import.problems: {count, plural, one {# row has a problem and will be skipped} other {# rows have problems and will be skipped}}
import.confirm: Import {count, plural, one {# player} other {# players}}
